project_title: Scientifically Controlled Improvement of Breast Cancer Multimodal GIT

dataset_manifest.cohort_reconciliation: 311 unique root patients + 4 repeat visits = 315 patient folders (220 train + 48 val + 47 test). The previously cited 314 was an arithmetic typo in an earlier markdown summary row for 220+48+47.

feature_cache.integrity_status: 100% disjoint splits, 100% label concordance with TSV

governance_rules.rule_1: C3 checkpoint and all Phase C artifacts frozen and preserved.
governance_rules.rule_2: Held-out 47-patient test cohort strictly excluded from Phase D training, tuning, and model selection.
governance_rules.rule_3: Zero test label or prediction file inspection during development.
governance_rules.rule_4: Development restricted strictly to 220 train and 48 val patients.
governance_rules.rule_6: No silent changes to architecture, weights, or evaluation metrics.
governance_rules.rule_7: Research radiologic triage scope only; no clinical diagnostic claims.
governance_rules.rule_8: Audit-first gate enforced prior to training.
